lean-render-live._comment: Lean 车道渲染验证（#844/#846 的客户端一半）。载荷由发货 Rust trim 从全量 fixture 生成（scripts/screenshots/gen-lean-render-fixtures.mjs + desktop/src-tauri 的 generate_render_fixtures 测试），走真实移动端 UI 与真实投影。断言：① 无正文的 reasoning 块仍渲染出思考行；② 工具行 target = shell 全命令 / 文件类 basename；③ tool_end 无 text 时 exit_code≠0 判失败、=0 判完成、裸 grep exit 1 由客户端软失败豁免放行。第 8 行是『旧 agent 只有 [exit: N] 页脚』的形状：lean 车道上它没有 outcome 可读，读作已运行（本场景把它一并钉住，见报告）。

image-zoom._comment: Pinch and double-tap the preview with real TouchEvents and assert what RN applied, so a regression fails the run. The controller works in coordinates relative to the picture, so a centred pinch must leave the picture in place, which is asserted too (an earlier version anchored on a window origin measured once per layout, which a sliding-in sheet made stale — the pinch then threw the picture off screen). Absolute focal offsets are not asserted: the browser's measureInWindow is in page space while the dispatched touches are in viewport space, so in the harness only 'did the scale change' is meaningful (the anchor math is covered by zoomableImage.test.ts).

steps.eval: (() => { const img = [...document.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(n => n.getBoundingClientRect().width > 100).sort((a, b) => b.getBoundingClientRect().width - a.getBoundingClientRect().width)[0]; if (!img) throw new Error('no preview image'); const touch = (x, y, id) => new Touch({ identifier: id, target: img, clientX: x, clientY: y, pageX: x, pageY: y }); const fire = (type, points, changed) => img.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, touches: points, targetTouches: points, changedTouches: changed ?? points })); window.__zoomScale = () => { let node = img, t = 'none'; while (node && t === 'none') { t = getComputedStyle(node).transform; node = node.parentElement; } if (t === 'none') return 1; const parts = t.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/); return parts ? parseFloat(parts[1].split(',')[0]) : 1; }; window.__zoomTranslate = () => { let node = img, t = 'none'; while (node && t === 'none') { t = getComputedStyle(node).transform; node = node.parentElement; } const parts = t === 'none' ? null : t.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/); return parts ? { x: Number(parts[1].split(',')[4]), y: Number(parts[1].split(',')[5]) } : { x: 0, y: 0 }; }; window.__zoomPinch = () => { const r = img.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.x + r.width / 2, cy = r.y + r.height / 2; const pair = (s) => [touch(cx - s, cy, 1), touch(cx + s, cy, 2)]; fire('touchstart', pair(30)); for (const s of [45, 60, 80, 100]) fire('touchmove', pair(s)); fire('touchend', [], pair(100)); }; window.__zoomDoubleTap = () => { const r = img.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.x + r.width * 0.3, y = r.y + r.height * 0.3; for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const one = [touch(x, y, 1)]; fire('touchstart', one); fire('touchend', [], one); } }; return 1; })()
(() => { window.__zoomPinch(); return window.__zoomScale(); })()

(() => { const s = window.__zoomScale(); const t = window.__zoomTranslate(); if (!(s > 1.5)) throw new Error('pinch did not zoom, scale=' + s); if (Math.abs(t.x) > 40 || Math.abs(t.y) > 40) throw new Error('the pinched picture left its focal point: ' + JSON.stringify(t)); return { scale: s, translate: t }; })()
(() => { window.__zoomDoubleTap(); return 'tapped'; })()
(() => { const s = window.__zoomScale(); if (!(s < 1.5)) throw new Error('double-tap did not return to fit, scale=' + s); return s; })()
